thread:
olivia: Auditor asked for a single artifact bundle covering encryption/key rotation evidence (SOC 2) and key management controls (ISO A.10). Also asked for vulnerability remediation timeline for RWI-2026-77. Can we assemble?

jia: Got it. I'll own the control-to-artifact mapping. Raj — can you grab KMS rotation history + key policy diffs and export CloudTrail events that reference KMS key ops?

raj: On it. ETA ~30m. Commands I'll run: `aws cloudtrail lookup-events --lookup-attributes AttributeKey=EventName,AttributeValue=RotateKMSKey --start-time 2023-01-01 --end-time 2024-06-15` then filter by KeyId. Upload path: s3://redwood-evidence/1718504210/kms-exports/

olivia: Make sure to include key-ids, keyARNs, rotation timestamps, and the principal that initiated each rotation. Auditor cares about env separation (prod/dedicated/private).

samir: I opened the vuln triage ticket for RWI-2026-77 (VULN-7773). Patch timeline: staging 2024-06-18, prod 2024-06-21. PRs linked in ticket: https://git.redwood/patches/7773. I'll attach the remediation plan and test run logs to the bundle.

jia: Auditor Q: they want proof RBAC changes go through the SRE change board and that approvals are recorded. We have PR approvals + Confluence approval notes. Raj — can you export PR review history and JIRA changelog for the RBAC CLs?

raj: Yep. Plan: export PR reviews via GH API: `curl -H "Accept: application/vnd.github.v3+json" https://api.github.com/repos/redwood/infra/pulls?state=closed` then `jq` to pull `reviews[].user.login`, `reviews[].state`, and timestamps. Also will pull JIRA issue changelog for the associated change requests.

audit-bot: evidence-bundle uploaded to staging: s3://redwood-evidence/1718504210/evidence-bundle-v1.zip :package: (contains kms-rotation.csv, cloudtrail.jsonl, pr-reviews.json, vuln-triage.pdf, ir-2026-04-postmortem.pdf)

olivia: :thumbsup: Good. Jia, can you produce a short cover note mapping each file to SOC 2 control IDs and ISO control clauses? Auditor specifically asked for a simple table mapping artifacts -> control IDs.

jia: Working on a Confluence draft: /spaces/SEC/pages/Control+Map+1718504210. Will include an inline excerpt in the manifest (Control Map + brief justification). ETA EOD.

samir: Adding postmortem for IR-2026-04 into the bundle. Timeline, detection root cause, mitigation and SLA impacts included. Note: personal data redacted per privacy policy.

olivia: Auditor follow-up: do we have retention enforcement for CloudTrail exports (they want config + proof of lifecycle enforcement)?

raj: Yes — CloudTrail buckets have lifecycle + versioning. Example command to repro: ```aws s3api put-bucket-lifecycle-configuration --bucket redwood-cloudtrail --lifecycle-configuration file://lifecycle.json``` I'll include `lifecycle.json` and `bucket-versioning.json` and a short grep-able config export.

jia: Also adding a manifest.md with checksums (sha256s) and a control mapping snippet for quick review. I'll include contact info for reproducibility (sec-compliance@redwood.example) and a README that explains how to verify each artifact.

olivia: One more: auditor wants to confirm KMS key custody and emergency access procedures. Please include key custody policy excerpt and the key escrow/access log for last 12 months.

raj: Adding key-custody-policy.pdf and access-audit-12mo.csv. Redacting sensitive principal identifiers per policy, replacing with internal IDs.

jia: Final ask — auditor wanted a short statement that vulnerability timeline matches what we provided in the ticket and that patches were validated. I'll attach the test run logs and an engineer signoff snippet.

olivia: Great work. I'll reply to the auditor with the S3 bundle link + manifest once Jia finishes the mapping. Marking thread to be closed after auditor ack.

audit-bot: evidence-bundle checksum manifest uploaded: s3://redwood-evidence/1718504210/manifest-sha256.txt :white_check_mark:
